summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video ## Topology Process p02: Maya Optimize Model Topology and Transfer Clothing Details ### Introduction In this tutorial, we will go through the process of optimizing model topology and transferring clothing details in Marvelous Designer. This guide is aimed at enhancing your workflow when working with 3D clothing models. ### Checking UVs 1. **Enter the Clothing File and the Top File** - First, check if the UV on the front of the top is normal. - Then, check the UV on the back of the top. ### Smoothing the Grid 2. **Smoothing Out the Grid** - You need to smooth out the grid of the panels to make them more evenly distributed. - If the grid is uneven in Marvelous Designer, you don't have to worry. ### Adjusting Edge Points 3. **Adjusting Edge Points** - If you want to adjust the edge points, you need to adjust the points on two panels at the same time. ### Transferring UVs 4. **Transferring UVs** - After loosening the grid, we can transfer the UV of the high-mood panels to the panels of the top. - In the grid transfer attribute, we need to transfer the UV of the current panel according to the world coordinate. ### Position Transfer 5. **Transferring Top Position** - After the top panel has the same UV information as the clothing, we can transfer the top position according to the UV. - After the top panel has the same UV information, we can transfer the UV of the current panel according to the world coordinate. ### Manual Repairs 6. **Manual Repair and Transfer of Errors** - Identify where to manually repair and transfer errors. - After the top panel has the same UV information as the UV of the current panel, we can transfer the UV of the current panel according to the world coordinate. ### Dividing Clothing Types 7. **Dividing Clothing into Categories** - Divide the clothing into jackets, backpacks, and pants. ### Aligning Edge Points 8. **Aligning Edge Points** - Then, select the edge points and align the points. ### Conclusion - There you go for the second result. - Thank you for watching! Your participation is appreciated. ### Additional Notes - For adding details and transmitting high-level details for low-model, thank you for your attention. - Please note that there were instances where the screen visibility affected the workflow, and I will delete the invisible version. ### Acknowledgment Thank you for your continued support and engagement in this tutorial. ```
